Submit.condition: Authenticated requester owns this NEW ticket.

AssignTechnician.condition: Supervisor manages the ticket team; chosen technician must be eligible for that team.

StartWork.condition: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

PutOnHold.condition: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

Resume.condition: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

Resolve.condition: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

Close.condition: Authenticated requester owns this RESOLVED ticket; CLOSED tickets cannot reopen in this MVP.

Reopen.condition: Authenticated requester owns this RESOLVED ticket; CLOSED tickets cannot reopen in this MVP.

MakeAvailable.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

AssignAsset.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

TransferAsset.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

ReturnAsset.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SendForRepair.condition: Technician has assigned linked work, or asset administrator controls the asset; preserve repair and parts invariants.

CompleteRepair.condition: Technician has assigned linked work, or asset administrator controls the asset; preserve repair and parts invariants.

RetireAsset.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

DisposeAsset.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

ReceiveStock.condition: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

ReserveStock.condition: Store officer controls location, or technician has assigned linked work; prevent oversubscription.

TransferStock.condition: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

ReturnStock.condition: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

AdjustStock.condition: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

IssueReservation.condition: Store officer controls source and destination locations; validate quantities, references and mandatory reasons.

CancelReservation.condition: Store officer controls stock location, or technician owns the linked part request; cancel only outstanding quantity.

RequestPart.condition: Authenticated technician is assigned to this ticket; enforce workflow and linked repair/parts constraints.

SaveSLAPolicies.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SaveCategories.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SaveSubcategories.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SaveTeams.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SaveLocations.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SaveWaitingReasons.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

SaveEscalationRules.condition: Validate role, record scope and current business state; reject direct field writes.

CheckSLA.condition: Technician reads assigned tickets, supervisor manages team tickets, manager reads all; only CheckSLA can write escalation history.

PreviewSLA.condition: Technician reads assigned tickets, supervisor manages team tickets, manager reads all; only CheckSLA can write escalation history.

ChangePriority.condition: Supervisor manages the ticket team; chosen technician must be eligible for that team.

CreateTicket.condition: Requester must equal authenticated employee; use active configuration and assigned asset.

CreateInventoryItem.condition: Create catalogue items and receive into permitted locations; equipment creates shared assets.

ReceiveEquipment.condition: Receive serialized equipment into permitted locations; backend allocates tags.
